title: lint: a lookup or master_detail field whose reference is a stored-metadata-body table saves, builds and validates, but the engine never hydrates it — refuse it at authoring time
body:
Filing gate **①**, a metadata-authoring trap: the authoring doors accept a declaration the runtime can only refuse. It is the authoring half of #24358's open question (a), **ruled B by the maintainer**. Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367) · `os-project-manager` · `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's; the seat reads it as `domain:spec` (`packages/lint`, and `packages/spec`'s field describe).

## The ruling

#24358's dev report 6253491408 put one open question to the maintainer.
- **The question:** besides the engine guards PR #24382 landed, should the authoring doors also refuse a `lookup` or `master_detail` whose `reference` is a stored-metadata-body table?
- **The options:** A, engine guards only; B, also an authoring refusal.

The maintainer, in this seat's session:
- 「24358 同意」, to the seat's recommendation B;
- then 「ok」, to the seat's follow-up recommendation on the rule's shape:
  - the refusal keys on the existing closed set (`isStoredMetadataBodyObject` in `@objectstack/spec/kernel`), the same predicate every other refusal of this family reads;
  - ⛔ no new authorable object key now (an `enable.relationshipTarget`-style flag was weighed: today it has no pull beyond these two platform tables, and `enable.apiEnabled: false` already covers an app's unexposed object at `$expand`, #22661);
  - so that if an app needs it later, swapping the set for a declaration is a change of the predicate's source, not a new rule.

## The trap (read on `origin/main` `f89d29e382`)

- **The family.** `STORED_METADATA_BODY_OBJECTS` is `sys_metadata` and `sys_metadata_history` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/stored-metadata-body-objects.ts`).
- **The runtime refuses every relationship read of it.** This has been so since PR #24344 (#24316) and PR #24382 (#24358):
  - the one-hop formula loader refuses a hop into the family;
  - the engine's `expand` keeps the field's stored id and never nests the row;
  - the master-detail `parent` root stays unbound in all three binders, so a rule reading `parent` refuses every write it judges.
- **The authoring doors accept the declaration.** #24358's dev measured it on a booted stack:
  - the metadata save door accepted a `lookup` (1/1) and a `master_detail` (1/1) into the family;
  - `os validate` and `os build` accepted both (exit 0).

  So an author (an AI writing a metadata app most of all) can declare a relationship that never works. A lookup only ever shows an id. A master-detail child with any `parent` rule refuses every write, and nothing at save says why.
- **The rest of the family already refuses at authoring time**, with the one prescription `STORED_METADATA_BODY_PRESCRIPTION`:
  - a hook bound to a family table (`HookSchema`, `data/hook.zod.ts`);
  - a flow write node aimed at one (`FlowSchema`, `automation/flow-node-config-refusals.ts`);
  - a formula hop through a reference into one (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, `storedMetadataBodyReferencesOf`, #24316).

  The reference field itself is the one declaration still accepted.

## Ask

- **One authoring refusal.** A `lookup` or `master_detail` field whose `reference` is in the family is refused where the hop refusal already runs, so `os validate`, `os build` and the object save door refuse it alike.
  - The refusal names the field, the target and the rule, and ends on `STORED_METADATA_BODY_PRESCRIPTION`.
  - It keys on `isStoredMetadataBodyObject`, the existing collector (`storedMetadataBodyReferencesOf`) or its twin.
  - Pick the issue kind by the lint's existing families; ⛔ no new error code if one fits.
- **The convention written where an author reads it:** the `reference` describe in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, and the field-types page under `content/docs/**`. A reference to a stored-metadata-body table is refused, and why: its rows are served only through the metadata protocol's own door.
- **Pins:**
  - a `lookup` and a `master_detail` into each family table are refused at each door;
  - a reference to an ordinary platform table still saves (the control);
  - the existing hop refusal is unchanged.
- ⛔ **Not asked:**
  - no change to the engine guards (they stay for installed artifacts, which run no authoring rule);
  - no new object key;
  - no change to `apiEnabled`'s meaning.
- **Exposure:** 0 in-repo producers (#24358's dev: 0 files reference a family table; control, 26 reference an ordinary platform table). So the refusal breaks nothing shipped, and the changeset says what an app that declared such a field sees.
- **`Clause-②`:** a narrowing of what the authoring doors accept, so `no (narrowing)`, with a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review on the narrowing face before the queue.

## Dedupe

Semantic searches over this repository's issues, closed included:
- "lint refuse lookup master_detail reference to sys_metadata stored metadata body table at save": 34 hits. The nearest are #24358 (the engine guards, closed) and #24316 (the one-hop refusal, closed); the rest are other `sys_metadata` defects.
- "authoring rule reference field into metadata table never expands": 5 hits, none on this rule. #3583, closed, is lint reference integrity in general.

#22661 (`$expand` and `apiEnabled`, closed) is a different declaration. None asks for this refusal.
